definitions.explanation: Rock or mineral from which metal or valuable minerals can be extracted. A key term in mining and geology.

examples.japanese: {鉱石|こうせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{採掘|さいくつ}→採掘：07996_saikutsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鉱石|こうせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: Iron ore can be extracted from this mountain.

examples.japanese: {鉱石|こうせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}っている→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。

examples.english: Metals are extracted by refining ore.

notes:
Compound of {鉱|こう} (mine/mineral) and {石|せき} (stone). A fundamental term in geology, mining, and industry. Japan historically imported most of its ore, making {鉱石|こうせき} a common word in discussions of trade and resources.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鉄鉱石|てっこうせき}: iron ore
- {銅鉱石|どうこうせき}: copper ore
- {鉱石|こうせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{採掘|さいくつ}→採掘：07996_saikutsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to mine ore
- {鉱石|こうせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{精錬|せいれん}→精錬：21301_seiren⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to refine ore
- {鉱石|こうせき}⟦ラジオ→ラジオ：01541_rajio⟧: crystal radio — a simple radio receiver using a crystal detector

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鉱物|こうぶつ}→鉱物：04149_koubutsu⟧: mineral — a broader category; all ores are minerals but not all minerals are ores
- ⟦{宝石|ほうせき}→宝石：03619_houseki⟧: gemstone; jewel — a precious or decorative stone, different purpose than ore
- {原石|げんせき}: raw stone; uncut gem — an unprocessed stone, especially a gemstone before cutting
